entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The largest and most developed city on Tazeem, built atop the dam forming Halimar; destroyed by the Eldrazi and later rebuilt.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: Continent of Zendikar where Sea Gate stands.

entities.name: Halimar
entities.description: Tazeem's inland sea, held back by the dam beneath Sea Gate.

entities.name: Lighthouse
entities.description: Tower at Sea Gate's eastern edge, once the center of learning on Tazeem, tended by merfolk mages.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: Eldrazi titan that assaulted Sea Gate.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: Eldrazi titan that assaulted Sea Gate.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: Planeswalker who shattered the hedron network restraining the titans.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: Alliance formed on cliffs overlooking Sea Gate, named for the fallen city.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Planeswalker who returned to Zendikar after the War of the Spark and hired Kesenya's expeditionary team.

entities.name: Nissa
entities.description: Planeswalker who helped Nahiri obtain the key to the lithoform core.

entities.name: Kesenya
entities.description: Leader of an expeditionary house who met Nahiri and gave Jace a note reading Murasa.

entities.name: Battle for Zendikar
entities.description: Conflict against the Eldrazi after which Sea Gate was rebuilt.

events.summary: Ulamog and Kozilek assault Sea Gate; Ob Nixilis shatters the hedron network restraining the titans, unleashing them on the city.
events.quote: Ob Nixilis shattered the hedron network restraining the titans

events.summary: The Gatewatch forms on cliffs overlooking Sea Gate.
events.quote: The formation of the Gatewatch occurred on cliffs overlooking Sea Gate

events.summary: After the titans' defeat, Sea Gate is rebuilt.
events.quote: Following the defeat of the Eldrazi titans, Sea Gate was rebuilt

events.summary: Nahiri meets Kesenya and hires her team to head for the Murasa Skyclave.
events.quote: she met with Kesenya and arranged to hire the expeditionary house's team

events.summary: Jace questions Kesenya and receives a note saying Murasa.
events.quote: he received a note from her that simply said "Murasa"

relations.quote: the largest and most developed city on the continent of Tazeem

relations.note: took its name from the fallen city
relations.quote: the Gatewatch took its name from the fallen city
